en.headline: New mortgage insurance approvals and drawdowns hit multi-year lows in October
en.dek: The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation recorded 701 new approvals in October, the lowest in nearly 11 years, while new drawdowns fell more than 40 per cent.
body: New approvals under the Mortgage Insurance Programme fell to 701 cases in October, down 2.4 per cent from the previous month and the lowest level in nearly 11 years, according to figures from the Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation.

The value of new approvals rose 1.1 per cent to HK$3.9 billion. New drawdowns of mortgage insurance loans, however, dropped more than 40 per cent in both number and value, also reaching multi-year lows. The average size of a newly drawn-down insured loan was about HK$5.29 million.

Centaline Mortgage said the sharp fall in drawdowns reflected weaker property transaction volumes after the market consolidated in the second half of the year. It noted that the relaxation of the maximum loan-to-value ratio to 70 per cent had reduced demand for higher-ratio insured mortgages.

For the first 10 months of 2026, new approvals totalled 10,408 cases worth HK$57 billion, down 23.8 per cent and 16.7 per cent respectively from the same period last year. New drawdowns also declined by more than 22 per cent in number and 16 per cent in value.

zh.headline: 十月新批按保及新取用按保宗數創逾十年新低
zh.dek: 按揭證券公司數字顯示，十月新批按保701宗，近十一年最低；新取用按保宗數及金額大跌逾四成。
body: 香港按揭證券有限公司數字顯示，十月新批按揭保險計劃宗數跌至701宗，按月減少2.4%，創近十一年新低。
新批按保金額按月微升1.1%至39億元。至於新取用按保貸款，宗數及金額均大跌逾四成，同樣創逾十年低位。平均新取用按保貸款金額約529萬元。
中原按揭指出，新取用宗數大幅回落，主要因為年中後樓市交投減少，按揭申請跟隨回落。該公司又提到，銀行按揭成數上限回復至七成後，市場對高成數按揭保險的需求出現結構性減少。
今年首十個月新批按保共10408宗、金額570億元，按年分別減少23.8%及16.7%。新取用按保宗數按年減少22.5%，金額減少16.1%。
